provenance.method: driven through scripts/check-architecture-guards.mjs --runtime-route-catalog-fixtures=<path> exactly like tests/run-event-ledger-guard-self-test.test.ts; every case lists its exact expected finding set (empty for clean/positive cases); a guard that merely fails is not a pass
provenance.author: independent red author (public-guards domain), 2026-10-02
frozenShapes: fixture shape per design D5 (:417-425): top-level S26/S27/S28/S29/S30/S48/S50 -> {cases:[{caseId,files:[{file,source}],expectedFindings:[{rule,file,symbol,owner,ownerSection}]}]}; header keys fixtureVersion/evidenceClass/sourceRefs/provenance sit beside them and are not cases
caseId unique across the whole file; <matched>/<cases> counts every case of all seven keys

symbol for route-dispatch-outside-owner = the innermost enclosing named declaration (function, const-bound arrow, or the runtime-keyed map binding itself); lookups into a flagged map are not reported separately

symbol for retired-route-selector = the canonical retired export name (also when imported under an alias, used through a namespace, re-exported under an alias or bound to a forwarding const); a restored retired module file yields one finding whose symbol is the module basename without extension (adapter-selector, runtime-registry)

symbol for leaf-adapter-import-outside-catalog = the imported leaf run/create export name; one tuple per symbol per file (import and call collapse into the same tuple); type-only imports are not findings

symbol for route-catalog-forbidden-dependency = the import specifier exactly as written in the importing file; the readiness cycle is reported on runtime-readiness.ts, a router reached through a one-hop wrapper is reported on the catalog file with the wrapper specifier

symbol for route-catalog-owner-bypass = the imported owner symbol, "process.env", or the imported module specifier for fs/config reads ("node:fs", "../claude-config"); owner = the existing canonical owner file of the imported symbol, and the catalog file itself for env/fs/config reads
symbol for duplicate-route-catalog = the imported constructor/validator name used by a production file

symbol for route-catalog-test-port-in-production = "runtimeRouteCatalog" for a non-forwarded host option assignment, or the called query/list/projection function name when a non-forwarded catalog argument is passed

symbol for renderer-route-projection-bypass = the enclosing named declaration of the runtime branch (getOrCreateChat, createNewSubChat, createRuntimeRouteTransport) or the binding name of a main-side runtimeId->transportId literal map
owner = src/main/lib/agent-runtime/runtime-route-catalog.ts for every route rule except route-catalog-owner-bypass adjacent-owner violations; ownerSection = Runtime Route Catalog Single Owner for all
